description: The signed-in member's backtest loops, newest first: each one's id, status, whether it is active (`active` is true while it is running or waiting for more Quant usage), its markets, how many strategies it found against how many the plan asked for, its attempts, the time it has used against its limit, when it started and ended, and its report_url. `active: true` lists only the ones still going; `active: false` only the ones that ended. The first one listed is the member's most recent loop. To read what a loop found, call quant_get_backtest_loop_info for its strategies' ids (best first) and quant_get_backtest_loop_strategy for one strategy's code and backtests. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

active.description: true: only loops still going; false: only loops that ended. Default: both.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

limit.description: Max loops (default 20, the most one call returns).

name: quant_list_backtest_loops
title: List my backtest loops
